name: @mmr/contracts
description: Compact 0.31.x contracts and circuits for Midnight (registration, bond escrow, epoch proof I1-I8, nullifier claim). Not compiled in this repo's CI host.

scripts.compact:check: for f in src/registration.compact src/bond.compact src/epoch_proof.compact src/claim.compact; do compact compile --skip-zk $f dist/$(basename $f .compact); done
scripts.compact:build: echo 'ZK key generation requires a GPU-capable Midnight node. Use compact:check for type/syntax verification.' && exit 1
